steps.title: Listen
steps.body: We spend time with the people who feel the problem every day, on site, before we propose anything.
steps.deliverable: You get: a plain-language problem statement

steps.title: Map
steps.body: We trace how the work really flows and agree where the biggest delay is, and what fixing it is worth.
steps.deliverable: You get: a clear scope, budget and timeline

steps.title: Build
steps.body: We deliver in short stages with a demo every two weeks, so your team shapes it as it grows.
steps.deliverable: You get: a working application, early and often

steps.title: Stay
steps.body: We train your people, support the application and keep improving it as your operation changes.
steps.deliverable: You get: a named contact and a service agreement

industries.title: Healthcare & clinics
industries.body: Patient records, appointments and billing live in paper files, chat threads and separate spreadsheets. Staff retype the same details and patients wait.
industries.solution: Clinic management for dental and medical practices: charting and records, appointments with SMS reminders, billing, multiple branches, and it keeps working when the internet doesn't.
industries.outcome: Shorter queues, fewer lost records, and a front desk that stops retyping.

industries.title: Local government
industries.body: Permits, civil records and citizen requests move by hand between offices, and nobody can say where an application is. Disaster offices get minutes of flood warning, not hours.
industries.solution: Service and records applications with tracking and approvals, plus watershed-based flood early warning: rainfall forecasts matched to flood simulations, live river and rain sensors, and barangay-level risk alerts.
industries.outcome: Faster turnaround, accountable offices, and hours of flood warning instead of minutes.

industries.title: Retail & distribution
industries.body: Stock counts and sales disagree between branches, and the owner finds out at month-end.
industries.solution: Point-of-sale for stores and food businesses with inventory that updates as you sell, and ERP for distributors and multi-branch operators: finance, purchasing, sales and BIR-ready books on one set of numbers.
industries.outcome: Fewer stock-outs, no surprise shrinkage, and decisions made on today's numbers.

industries.title: Energy & power
industries.body: Solar output swings with the weather, rivers and floods reach a plant before the warning does, and the condition of equipment is only known after it fails.
industries.solution: Solar forecasting for solar companies. Hydrology and flood inundation modelling for hydro and thermal plants. Digital twins of plants and equipment.
industries.outcome: Better dispatch and trading decisions, earlier flood warnings, and maintenance planned before breakdowns.

industries.title: Banking & finance
industries.body: Approvals and signed documents stall in email, and every handoff adds a day.
industries.solution: E-signing and document workflow: approvals routed to the right person, a tamper-evident audit trail, and signing embedded in your own systems through an API. Built around RA 8792 and the Data Privacy Act.
industries.outcome: Decisions in hours instead of days, and a clean trail for every audit.

industries.title: Manufacturing & BPO
industries.body: Production, targets and handovers are tracked in separate sheets, so managers manage by phone call.
industries.solution: Project and portfolio tracking for PMOs and IT teams, with project health, budgets and risks in one place and status reports leadership actually reads, plus operations dashboards for the floor and the queue.
industries.outcome: Fewer blind spots, steadier output, and managers who plan instead of chase.

industries.title: Sports & recreation
industries.body: Courts and venues are booked by chat message and notebook, so slots go unfilled and nobody is sure who has paid.
industries.solution: Court and venue booking for players, clubs and owners: live availability with GCash and Maya checkout, memberships and tournaments, and a venue portal with POS, QR check-in and reports.
industries.outcome: Fuller calendars, payments collected up front, and owners who see the whole venue from one screen.

ai_services.title: Agentic AI
ai_services.body: Agents that take on multi-step work instead of only answering questions. They read a request, plan the steps, use your systems to carry them out, and ask a person to approve anything that matters.
ai_services.outcome: Routine work such as triage, reconciliation and routing approvals is done for you, and staff handle only the exceptions.

ai_services.title: RAG knowledge assistants
ai_services.body: An assistant that answers questions from your own manuals, procedures, policies and regulations, and shows the source for every answer. It only shows people what they are already allowed to see.
ai_services.outcome: Staff find the right answer quickly instead of searching shared drives, and every answer can be checked.

ai_services.title: Document intelligence
ai_services.body: Software that reads forms, invoices, permits and records, pulls out the details you need, and enters them into your systems. Anything it is unsure about goes to a person to check.
ai_services.outcome: Less retyping, fewer data-entry errors, and records you can finally search.

ai_services.title: Forecasting and prediction
ai_services.body: Models that learn from your historical and sensor data to forecast demand, solar output, river levels or equipment failure, with a clear range of uncertainty and not a single number.
ai_services.outcome: Earlier warnings, better planning, and maintenance scheduled before something breaks.

ai_services.title: Responsible AI
ai_services.body: We set up the safeguards around every AI system: access controls, audit logs, testing against your real cases, and handling of personal data under the Data Privacy Act.
ai_services.outcome: AI your auditors, regulators and staff can trust, with a record of what it did and why.
